text:
Zara: Hi everyone, first day! Quick org/ownership Qs: who signs off on model onboarding for production (evals, PII review)? Also who owns the SLA for hosted vs dedicated deployments?

Devon: welcome @Zara :tada: Model onboarding approvals are split: applied-ml owns eval quality + metrics (cc @Sam), security-eng reviews PII/data handling, and product signs off on feature-scope.

Sam: hi @Zara - applied-ml (that's me) handles the eval checklist. Send model artifacts and the eval config. We use the template at https://go/redwood/model-onboard-template. Typical items: datasets, regret tests, perf regression thresholds.

Zara: thanks. Who runs the privacy review? Is that security-eng or legal?

Anu: security-eng does the initial K-anonymity / data flow checks. Anything that touches customer data or external vendors gets a legal review too. Process: security-eng -> legal (if flagged). Use label: "onboard:privacy" in the ticket.

Devon: SLA ownership: hosted API SLAs are product + ops (we coordinate uptime targets), Dedicated SLA (reserved capacity) is owned by Dedicated product + eng-platform for uptime/throughput guarantees. Private deployments SLA is contract/legal + customer-success for commitments.

Zara: helpful. One more: if a model fails quality checks after release (e.g., hallucination spike), what's the immediate escalation and rollback path?

Sam: we try staged rollouts + canary monitors. Quick path: revert to previous model tag in the serving config (eng-runtime handles rollout), trigger an incident runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/model-regression. Pager path: model-monitor -> eng-sre -> applied-ml -> product.

hr-bot: Welcome message: please complete the security training within 5 days.

Anu: Ownership cheat-sheet (quick):
- Eval & regressions: applied-ml (Sam)
- Privacy & keys: security-eng (Anu)
- Serving rollouts & runtime: eng-runtime
- Capacity & Dedicated SLAs: eng-platform + product
- Customer contract SLAs: legal + customer-success

Zara: perfect. Is there a single "who-to-ask" doc that maps these surfaces? Would save a lot of hunting.

Devon: we have a living doc but it's scattered across runbooks. I'll consolidate a single page and drop it in the onboarding folder. Will ping this thread when done.

Zara: amazing 10x. Tagging this for my onboard notes. Thanks all! :pray:
